data.long_description:
Belair at DAMAC Hills by Trump Estates is a prestigious gated community offering the epitome of luxury living within a serene enclave overlooking the Trump International Golf Club Dubai. This collection of 3 to 6-bedroom townhouses and 5 to 9-bedroom villas is thoughtfully designed with sophisticated interiors featuring pale golds, creams, and bronzes, along with clean architectural lines and premium finishes. Each home embodies elegance, space, and tranquility—set against the backdrop of manicured greens and lush landscapes.

Developed by renowned DAMAC Properties, these two-storey villas offer a premium lifestyle complete with panoramic views, modern technology, and meticulous attention to detail. Every residence comes fully furnished and equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, a private pool, maid’s room, expansive balconies, and large windows that flood the interiors with natural light. Belair by Trump Estates ensures an exceptional standard of living that harmoniously blends comfort, style, and exclusivity.
